title: Continual Test-Time Domain Adaptation (CoTTA)
mechanism: The student learns from weight-averaged and augmentation-averaged teacher pseudo-labels, and source weights are stochastically restored to avoid forgetting.
adaptation: Port the loss to U-Net++ (their segmentation code is Segformer, non-commercial licence). Run per E1 module and episodically on test. It is the standard CTTA baseline the benchmark needs.
min_experiment: Arm: CoTTA on FINAL and SUP100-PF. Baseline: the same checkpoints without TTA. All metrics. This is a benchmark row; no kill line is needed, and the expected outcome is a crack recall loss.
evidence: R: Cityscapes-to-ACDC continual segmentation and CIFAR/ImageNet-C gains over Tent and source.
prior_overlap: None. The Mean Teacher SSL was a training-time method; CoTTA at test time was never run.
